# Pull Request

## Summary

Briefly describe what this pull request changes.

## Why this change is needed

Explain the problem being solved or the reason for the change.

## Type of change

Select the relevant option:

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test / CI
- [ ] Command library update
- [ ] Ranking / recommendation update
- [ ] Dependency update
- [ ] Other

## Affected area

Select all relevant areas:

- [ ] Command search
- [ ] Ranking / recommendations
- [ ] Filters
- [ ] Command combinations
- [ ] Command library
- [ ] Export
- [ ] Streamlit interface
- [ ] Installation / setup
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests / CI
- [ ] Other

## Testing performed

Describe how the change was tested.

Examples:

```text
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py
```

If relevant, also mention:

- Python version
- Operating system
- Browser used
- Streamlit version

## Command library considerations

If the pull request changes the command library:

- [ ] The command remains unique.
- [ ] The command description is clear.
- [ ] The command is assigned to the appropriate section.
- [ ] The change does not incorrectly present a user-defined codeword as an official ChatGPT command.
- [ ] The total command count was checked if commands were added or removed.

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation was updated if user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated if appropriate.
- [ ] `ATTRIBUTION.md` was reviewed if external inspiration or third-party material was introduced.

## Privacy and external services

Confirm where applicable:

- [ ] This change does not introduce telemetry without documentation.
- [ ] This change does not require private credentials to be committed.
- [ ] Any new external service or API dependency is clearly documented.

## Additional notes

Add screenshots, logs, implementation notes or known limitations here.
